The report should preserve the five-transfer allowance, allowed positional ranges, and three-player club limit, and it must keep all moves proposed rather than claiming execution or completion. Remember that the squad must own 4–6 defenders, but a legal 3-5-2 Top 11 formation uses three starting defenders.

Defensible alternatives and natural variations in wording or organization should receive full credit. The 4–6 defender rule governs the 15-player squad; it does not make a 3-5-2 Top 11 formation illegal.
